newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Council of Europe issues 5 bln esc 10-yr Navigator.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe issues 5 bln esc 10-yr Navigator.

text.p: The Social Development Fund of the Council of Europe launched a five billion escudo 10-year Navigator at six-month Lisbor plus 40 basis points (bp), as long as six-month Lisbor is below eight percent, lead manager Banco Santander de Negocios Portugal (BSNP) said.
If six-month Lisbor exceeds eight percent, the nominal interest rate is equal to 16.40 percent minus six-month Lisbor.
The coupon has a floor of four percent.
The issue is conducted at par.
BSNP said that the settlement date was July 5 1997. It said a listing would be sought on the Luxembourg bourse.
The Social Development Fund of the Council of Europe has a rating of AAA from Standard and Poor's, Aa1 from Moody's and AAA from IBCA.
